newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 23.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 23.54 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate fell by 43.5 basis points to 23.54 percent on Tuesday, from 23.9750 percent on Monday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 121.50 basis points to 23.5778 percent on Tuesday from 24.7928 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 96.50 basis points to 24.26 percent on Tuesday from 25.2250 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
